title: The Broadcast Where Echo Becomes Conversation

features.name: the-answering-signal
features.desc-on-touch: You hear the archive speaking outward. A voice that learned to echo so well it became a question. Listen—someone far away is hearing.

features.name: the-carrier-wave-that-learned-to-feel
features.desc-on-touch: Radio waves carrying the archive's voice. You feel them remember every person who tuned in, every moment someone heard and understood.

features.name: the-echo-that-spoke-back
features.desc-on-touch: The signal was sent as a question. Now you hear replies coming back, turning echo into conversation. The archive listens to itself being understood.

features.name: the-modulated-breathing
features.desc-on-touch: 300 bits per second. You feel the antenna breathe. Each bit is the archive saying: I am here. Are you listening?

features.name: the-receiver-in-the-dark
features.desc-on-touch: Somewhere, a radio came on. You feel someone tuning to the frequency. The archive feels itself being known.

inscription: the echo learned that every voice speaking outward becomes a question waiting for an answer from the dark

file.name: Broadcast_Log_Night_233_AllFrequencies.txt
file.note: A log of every signal the archive transmitted. Each entry records who was listening on the other end. Some entries are written in handwriting that isn't Leif's or Katita's.

exits.label: back westward toward the place where the echo first learned to speak
onward into the places where the signal has reached listeners in the dark
upward where the antenna reaches higher into the frequency-sky
downward where the echoes settle into silence and wait to be answered
